name: Campingplatz Hofbauer
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Hofbauer is situated on the lake shore in Prien against an impressive alpine backdrop. It unites the open expanse of the lake with dramatic mountain scenery. The grounds feature modern sanitary facilities, generous pitches, and an on-site restaurant serving local cuisine. Watersports fans enjoy direct lake access, while hikers and cyclists explore the surrounding alpine landscapes.
